title: Glutathione vs Vitamin C: Which Is Better for Dull Skin?
ex: Both are antioxidants for brighter-looking skin. See how glutathione and vitamin C differ, which suits your skin, and how to use them together.
rt: Glutathione vs Vitamin C: Which Suits You? | Mirc Glow
rd: Glutathione vs vitamin C: how these two antioxidants differ, which suits sensitive or oily skin, and how to use both in a simple morning and night routine.
quick: Neither simply wins. Vitamin C is the better-studied antioxidant for a brighter, more even-looking tone, while glutathione is usually gentler and suits a night cream. Many people use both: vitamin C in the morning under sunscreen, glutathione at night, or one cream that contains the two.
facts: Vitamin C oxidises with heat, air and light; a darkened serum is past its best.
Research on glutathione applied to skin is newer and limited.
The two can be used together without conflict.
Vitamin C does not replace sunscreen.
